## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta2

### Scheduler performance and mobile interaction
- Keep the managed-schedule dialog DOM persistent while it is open. Home Assistant state updates now refresh only status, native time rows and control state instead of rebuilding the whole dialog and stealing focus.
- Fix touch drag-and-drop by moving existing row nodes in place while pointer capture remains attached; the queue draft is finalized locally without a full render during `pointermove`.
- Replace the two-step Add zone selector/button flow with one selector: choosing a missing configured zone adds it immediately to the local draft. The selector remains disabled when every configured zone is represented.
- Make queue rows about 20–25% more compact while keeping dedicated repeat/remove/drag touch targets.
- Keep Start/End as Home Assistant native entity rows and give them concise display labels. Time changes continue to save immediately and remain independent from `Save order`.
- Keep the whole dialog body scrollable with a sticky Save footer and edge auto-scroll during drag.

### Lazy loading and integration fast path
- Stop the legacy beta5/beta6 eager scheduler registry discovery during normal card startup. Scheduler-specific fallback discovery now happens only when the Schedule button is actually opened and integration metadata is unavailable.
- Defer the card's general entity-registry fallback briefly so standard installations can load the lightweight Map API first. With Navimower 0.4.3-beta44+, the API supplies exact user-renamed entity/device identifiers and cancels the large browser-side registry scan.
- Continue supporting older Navimower integration versions through the existing registry fallback path.
